comments.author: Oraceon
comments.body_html:
Regarding mod conflicts:

- This preset will conflict with any mods that change the rate at which you gain skill levels (WIth the exception of Always Level Endurance by Fontaine)

- This preset will conflict with any mods that change hideout crafting/construction/production times

- This mod will conflict with any mods that change the default storage and pocket sizes of Scavs

- This mod will conflict with any mods that change loot spawning mechanics in any way

- This mod will conflict with any mods that change boss and cultist spawns in anyway

Possible Solutions:

- Some of these issues can be resolved by disabling conflict-specific changes in the Fair and Balanced Preset’s configuration

- Some of these issues can be resolved by having a custom load order that loads conflicting mods *After* SVM in the load order

None of these solutions are guaranteed to work with every conflicting mod, but have shown to work with a few. That being said, it is always recommended to build a custom load order in order to ensure compatibility.
